subject: Post-call: Prompt costs, batching levers & pilot ROI (LedgerZen)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@ledgerzen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Prompt costs, batching levers & pilot ROI (LedgerZen)

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned. I tried to keep this tight and actionable.

Call summary (what you said):
- Primary pain: high per-transaction inference cost for realtime fraud checks + long-term runway concerns if we scale past 200k tx/month.
- Latency SLO: <250ms for real-time route; can tolerate 1–5s for bulk nightly scoring.
- Data residency: US-only logs for audit; strict PII handling.
- Budget target: you mentioned ~$20k/month as the practical ceiling for the initial rollout.

Cost levers we discussed (how Redwood helps):
- Batching & request coalescing for the nightly scoring job (big upside, low latency requirement).
- Prefix/KV caching for repeated user prompts (significant token savings for repeat flows).
- Model routing: use lower-cost model variants for deterministic checks, fall back to higher-quality model only when needed.
- Quantization + reserved capacity option if you want cost predictability for production.

High-level economics (ballpark from our call):
- Baseline (no batching/caching): est. $25k–$30k / month for 200k monthly tx at current prompt sizes.
- With batching + caching and model routing: est. $11k–$16k / month (35–55% savings).
- Pilot target: demonstrate ~30–40% cost reduction while keeping realtime SLOs.

Proposed pilot (3 weeks):
1) Scope: nightly scoring (200k monthly equivalent) + a small live slice (5–10k/mo) for realtime checks.
2) Deliverables: cost baseline, batching savings report, latency SLOs, security checklist (SOC2 items + KMS plan).
3) Inputs we need from you: sample anonymized logs (redact PII), current prompt templates, approximate monthly query distribution by endpoint.
4) Success criteria: hitting <= $20k/month pro forma or demonstrating a clear path to that via levers above.

Attachments: initial econ estimate workbook + a simple batching flow diagram (see attached).

Next steps / asks:
- Alex: can you share a small sample (10k rows) of anonymized prompts & counts by endpoint? Ideally by EOD Mon (1/15) — this lets us run quick sim estimates.
- LedgerZen finance: confirm whether $20k/month is a hard cap for pilot approval, or a target that can stretch with demonstrated ROI.
- Internally: Marissa/Karthik — I’ll need a quick pricing sketch and pilot statement of work if LedgerZen confirms scope.

If this reads ok I’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to lock the pilot start date.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood-Econ-Estimate-LedgerZen.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet) — batching assumptions noted; batching-flow-diagram.png (png)
From: Alex Mercer <alex@ledgerzen.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: LedgerZen Finance <finance@ledgerzen.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 19:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Prompt costs, batching levers & pilot ROI (LedgerZen)

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear note. A couple quick clarifications before we pull the sample: 

1) Security/residency: we cannot permit any persistent storage of PII outside our VPC. How does Redwood handle cache persistence and auditability? Will cached KV stay in our environment for the pilot?

2) Budget: $20k/month is our current pilot cap — finance will consider a one-time stretch if the ROI shows <3 month payback, but that needs to be explicit. Can you produce a 3-month ROI projection?

3) Batching: for the nightly scoring job, we already batch at the app layer but it’s inefficient. If Redwood takes over batching at the inference layer, how do you measure and attribute token savings vs our existing batching?

We’re happy to share an anonymized sample (we need to remove user ids). I’ll coordinate with finance — expect a reply by Monday.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform Engineering | LedgerZen
alex@ledgerzen.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@ledgerzen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 07:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Prompt costs, batching levers & pilot ROI (LedgerZen)

Alex — great questions. Short answers up front, details below.

Security / residency: Redwood’s pilot can run in your VPC (Private deployment) or as a dedicated customer slice in our hosted region with US-only logging. Cache behavior: we support ephemeral in-memory KV caches by default (no disk persistence) and an optional customer-managed Redis inside your VPC for any durable caching needs — you control keys and retention. KMS/HSM integration is available for key control; we’ll include the security whitepaper and SOC2 evidence in the SOW.

Budget & ROI: we’ll produce a 3-month ROI projection once we have the sample traffic distribution. Rough quick math from the attached revised estimate: baseline cost ~$28k/mo; projected after levers ~$13k–$15k/mo -> ~2–3 month payback on pilot uplift if conversion/efficiency gains hold. I attached a version of the workbook with a conservative scenario column.

Batching attribution: we’ll run A/B instrumentation during the pilot. Redwood’s runtime reports per-route token consumption and will show token delta pre/post batching for identical prompts. If you can keep one small control slice on your current path we can compare directly and produce a line-item savings report.

Next internal items: Marissa/Karthik — we’ll need a one-page SOW and a pilot pricing SKU that includes a small one-time engineering setup fee + a pilot discount (requested by LedgerZen). Can you draft a sketch so I can share with Alex and finance?

Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync Tue 1/16 at 9:00am PT — I’ll hold a slot.

Thanks,
Soojin

Subject: Internal: LedgerZen pilot pricing sketch

Folks — quick internal note so we move fast if LedgerZen confirms:

1) Pilot SKU (3 weeks):
   - Eng setup: one-time $3,500 (includes VPC wiring or dedicated slice config + security review).
   - Pilot usage: meter at hosted rates but apply 30% pilot discount on token spend for first month (we can adjust).
   - Optional: reserved capacity uplift if they sign for dedicated within 60 days — we offer a 10% commit credit.

2) Rationale: their stated cap (~$20k/mo) is tight; to get them to sign we should show a conservative projection that hits sub-$20k after levers. The 30% pilot discount + eng setup call makes the first-month economics easier and gives us data to justify ongoing pricing.

3) Next asks for Soojin: include the pilot SKU line items + a 1-page SOW to share with LedgerZen. Also confirm we will instrument per-route token reporting and include a simple comparison dashboard (can be a shared Drive link).

Karthik — can you draft the SKU+SOW by EOD Mon? I’ll stand by to approve.

Thanks,
